title: Mafunso a Zaumoyo wa Wodwala - 9
instructions: M’masabata awiri apitawa, mwakhala mukuvutitsidwa kangati ndi mavuto awa?

questions.text: Kutaya chidwi kapena chisangalalo pochita zinthu
Kumva chisoni, kugwa mtima, kapena kusowa chiyembekezo
Vuto logona, kugona nthawi yayitali, kapena kudzuka nthawi zambiri
Kusowa njala kapena kudya mopitirira muyeso
Kumva zoipa za inu nokha kapena ngati mwakhumudwitsa inu kapena banja lanu
Vuto loika maganizo pa zinthu monga kuwerenga kapena kuonera televizioni
Kuyenda kapena kulankhula pang’onopang’ono kwambiri anthu akuzindikira, kapena kukhala wosakhazikika kuposa mwachizolowezi
Maganizo oti zingakhale bwino mutamwalira kapena kudzivulaza
